zh-CN.title: 更清爽的页面标题
items: 恢复手机端滚动后通栏标题背景，生日花园装饰移至聊天画布
生日主题按钮改为纯色，页签、底部面板、抽屉与模态框使用礼物和缎带装饰
生日概览与设置分层，生日信单独查看，四角饰件完整展现
通讯与菜单分组增加可伸缩的丝带和蝴蝶结装饰

en.title: Cleaner page headers
items: Restored full-width mobile headers on scroll and moved birthday garden decoration to the conversation canvas
Birthday buttons use solid colors, with gift and ribbon details for tabs, sheets, drawers and dialogs
Birthday overview, date settings and letters have separate views, with unclipped corner decorations
Communication and menu groups gain scalable ribbons and bows
